title: Lego Creates Sony PlayStation Set
paragraphs: More than 30 years after it was first released, the original PlayStation is back — sort of.
Lego is releasing a new set that will let you build your own replica of a Sony PlayStation console and controller.
Lego already has sets based on other popular consoles, like the Nintendo Game Boy, Atari 2600 and Sega Mega Drive. But it's the first PlayStation console to have its own Lego set.
The set has 1,911 pieces and is around the same size as the original PlayStation console when built.
Separate from the console is a wired controller that can be plugged into the front of the PlayStation, just like the original controllers.
The set also comes with two popular PlayStation games — but, of course, you can't actually play them!
Instead, you can build small dioramas of Ape Escape and Gran Turismo, and then slot them into the sides of the console.
Then, when you open the top of the PlayStation — where you'd put the game disc in a real PlayStation — you'll be able to see the dioramas from the top!
The set costs $179.99 and will be available everywhere from October 4.
The first PlayStation was released in Japan in December 1994, and quickly became popular.
According to PlayStation, over 102 million consoles were sold around the world between 1994 and 2006, after which they stopped being made.
